what_it_measured.text: The first step of the study aimed at determining the collagen absorption peak.
Cell images were taken every 20 min for 96 h with the objective EC Plan-Neofluar 10x/0,3 Ph1 M27.

dose.text: No negative effects were reported by collagen hydrolysate ingestion (one oral dose of 25 g dissolved in 200 mL of water).

Briefly, cell lysates were prepared using a Nonidet P-40 lysis buffer and incubated in an assay buffer (125 mm sodium acetate buffer (pH 5.2), 100 mm p-nitrophenyl phosphate (Sigma-Aldrich), and 1 mm L (+) sodium tartrate).

route.text: No negative effects were reported by collagen hydrolysate ingestion (one oral dose of 25 g dissolved in 200 mL of water).

endpoint.text: Total serum protein was quantified using the BCA kit (Sigma-Aldrich) according to the manufacturer’s protocol.
Bone mineral density was measured using an eXplore CT 120 scanner (GE Healthcare, Canada).
Mineralization was evaluated by light microscopy and was quantified by the ImageJ software.
